thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] gpu-farm: ECC error spike on multiple nodes — paging eng-oncall

jordan: acked. seeing the alert flood. moving to this thread.

maya: I'm on it, pulling prometheus graphs for ECC, temp, vram, and node drain counts.

jordan: quick note for context — noticed increased embedding latency reports from customers last 10m, likely related to retries. not major error rate but latency SLO slipping.

maya: prometheus snapshot: ECC errors jumped on gpu-node-13/14/21 around 2035008500. temps also rose ~6C then fan speed spiked. VRAM usage steady. no clear OOMs yet.

sam: hmm could be thermal throttling cascades leading to ECC flaps. any recent driver/firmware pushes?

lia: no infra deploys in last 24h. last firmware rollout was 3 weeks ago.

maya: running quick health commands now:
```
# check node ECC counters
kubectl exec -it node-exporter-13 -- curl localhost:9100/metrics | grep -i ecc
# check pod OOMs
kubectl get events --field-selector type=Warning -A | grep -i oom
```

maya: events show a few container restarts on batch-encoder pods on node-21 but not widespread.

jordan: customer impact: a handful of low-volume embedding jobs saw 2-3x latency. ops on alert but no 5xxs reported. marking 'partial degradation' for now.

incident-bot: paging policy: if sustained ECC errors on >=3 nodes for >5m, escalate to eng-sre. Currently 6 nodes flagged in last 15m.

tess: i'll take on escalation if we need to schedule drains. currently on the tail shift.

jordan: short-term mitigations: 1) suppress alert noise to avoid further pager fatigue (we're getting repeated single-sample spikes). 2) isolate high-noise nodes for controlled drain. 3) create dashboard panels to visualize rolling median so we can avoid flapping.

sam: agree. propose alert tuning change: require ECC error rate >3 errors/min averaged over 10m (was 1 error/min over 2m). add a 3m cool-off window to not repage for 10m after a suppression. also add label with node-role so we can exclude known noisy preemptible pool.

jordan: make the change but note we need a rollback plan if we miss a real failure. put a runbook link in the alert.

maya: i'm drafting an alertmanager patch now. diff snippet:
```
- alert: GPU_ECC_Errors
- expr: increase(gpu_ecc_errors_total[2m]) > 1
+ alert: GPU_ECC_Errors_Sustained
+ expr: increase(gpu_ecc_errors_total[10m]) / 10 > 3
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-ecc
```

maya: also adding an `annotations.suppression` flag so on-call UI shows if an automated suppression is active.

lia: on dashboards: propose new panels: 30m rolling median ECC, thermal delta (5m rolling), VRAM fragmentation (small allocation failure counts), drain/eviction timeline. I'll put them in `dashboards/gpu-health` and share link.

jordan: agree. also add a tiny rule for thermal flapping: only consider temp > 85C sustained for 5m AND ECC rate spike. that should reduce flapping when fans overshoot briefly.

maya: taking action now: 1) apply alertmanager patch to reduce noise (will route to non-pager for 10m while we validate) 2) cordon + drain plan for most noisy nodes: gpu-node-13 and gpu-node-21. plan: `rctl cordon gpu-node-13 && rctl drain gpu-node-13 --grace-period=60`

maya: executing drain sequence on node-13 now. will monitor backlog and pod reschedules.

ops-bot: drain started on gpu-node-13 at 2035009022 by maya (jobs will be rescheduled).

maya: node-13 drained cleanly, rebooting to clear PCIe ECC state: `ssh ops@gpu-node-13 sudo reboot`.

jordan: good. collect `nvidia-smi -q` and `dmesg` pre/post reboot and attach to ticket.

maya: uploaded logs to ticket #INC-4121. found repeated PCIe parity errors in dmesg, not just GPU ECC counters. tagging hw-team.

sam: hw-team note: parity errors often correlate with cable seating or riser issues. if PCIe errors persist after reboot, we should schedule rack-level inspection.

maya: reboot done on node-13. post-reboot ECC counters stable so far (10m tail).

jordan: good sign. still seeing spikes on node-14 and node-21. planning targeted drains for node-14 next; node-21 had restarts — leaving it for now until we confirm reschedules stabilise.

lia: created dashboard PR: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd123/gpu-health — includes median panels and new alert links.

jordan: action items (short):
- maya: finish alertmanager patch and plant suppression metadata (ETA 15m)
- lia: merge dashboard PR and add crosslink in runbook (ETA 30m)
- tess: night handoff watcher to monitor for recurrence between 0000-0600 UTC (assigned)
- sam: follow up with hw-team on rack inspection if node-21 parity persists (create ops ticket)

maya: patched alertmanager and removed immediate pager routing; new alert will fire as non-pager for 10m while we validate. patch: https://git.internal/ops/alertmanager/commit/7b9f

incident-bot: note — alert routing changed by maya at 2035009150, pager routing suppressed for 10m per trial rule.

jordan: customer impact summary for handoff: partial degradation to embedding latency observed for ~20 minutes, root cause likely transient ECC/PCIe parity issues on 3 nodes. mitigations: drained + rebooted node-13, applied alert tuning to reduce noise, dashboards updated. No ongoing 5xxs.

tess: thanks — i'll monitor the non-pager alerts and if ECC >3 nodes again for 10m i'll escalate to eng-sre. leaving this thread open for any follow-ups.

maya: leaving logs & runbook links in INC-4121. will post hw-team updates there.

jordan: thumbs up. closing active mitigation here. any regression — re-pager or reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
